title: Unified Logistics Telemetry Aggregation
business: A regional logistics firm managing a fleet of automated warehouse robots and delivery drones.
problem: Operational teams struggle with fragmented visibility, as robot diagnostic logs, drone flight telemetry, and warehouse environmental sensors reside in isolated silos, preventing rapid incident response.
solution: Grafana acts as a centralized observability layer by utilizing its data source plugin architecture to query disparate systems—Prometheus for robot metrics, Loki for drone logs, and Postgres for warehouse sensor state—into a single pane of glass.
steps: Install Grafana OSS on a centralized management server.
Configure individual data source plugins for Prometheus, Loki, and Postgres to establish connectivity.
Create a unified dashboard using panel visualizations to correlate robot battery levels with drone flight logs.
Define alerting rules within Grafana to trigger notifications when sensor thresholds are breached.
Grant role-based access to regional managers for specific dashboard views.
outcome: Operational teams achieve a holistic view of the supply chain, enabling faster identification of cross-system failures and reducing the time spent manually correlating data across disconnected platforms.
limitation: The primary limitation is the potential for increased latency when querying high-cardinality data across multiple remote sources simultaneously, which can be checked by monitoring the query execution time in the Grafana Explore panel.
